parse.title: Common Misconceptions
parse.wikitext:
These are the false claims this wiki exists to correct.
1. '''"The Original Vampire gamepass costs 1,800 Robux."''' False — it's 1,895 Robux, or 1,706 with the Premium discount.
2. '''"You choose Natural-Born at spawn" / "Natural-Born is a 1% random roll."''' Both wrong — Natural-Born Vampire comes from the Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass.
3. '''"Turning is just dying / just getting bitten."''' Both simplifications are wrong — the sequence involves vampire blood in your system + death + drinking blood.
4. '''"You become a ghost when killed."''' False — there is no ghost state in the game; once you die, you just respawn.
5. '''"Vampires can hide in churches."''' False — vampires burn in holy places and can't enter church interiors.
6. '''"A Temporary Sun Ring costs exactly X."''' Prices of 5,000 / 1,000 (hat) / witch-crafted-only all circulate.
7. '''"Werewolves come from a quest, boss, or shop."''' False — only a back scratch from a werewolf (5% per scratch) on a Human, transforming at the full moon.
8. '''"Cannibal Raised is just a cosmetic race."''' False — it's a stronger variant that resets your level.
9. '''"Getting bitten by an Original makes you an Original" / "You can level or age your way to Original."''' Both false — the Original Vampire (ANTICIPATED) gamepass is the only way, confirmed on the game's Discord.
